items.heading: Faraa
details: Key ingredients: rice flour, mustard oil, cumin, garlic
Knead rice flour with hot water into a soft dough.
Shape into small dumplings and steam until translucent.
Temper mustard oil with cumin and garlic.
Toss the steamed dumplings in the tempering before serving.

items.heading: Chhattisgarhi Chicken Curry
details: Key ingredients: chicken, onion, garlic, mustard oil, local spices
Saute onion and garlic in mustard oil until golden.
Add chicken pieces and cook until sealed on all sides.
Add a simple blend of everyday spices and a little water.
Simmer until the chicken is tender and the gravy is well combined.
